title: Hidden Secrets
summary: A surf instructor is found shot dead in a locked room.
method: It was suicide staged as a robbery, so that the wife could still get an insurance. However, it was actually murder because the victim was lied to and never actually had a terminal illness.
motive: The killer was in love with the victim's wife
notes: Humphrey and Camille watch Boris Karloff's The Mummy. It's not really explained why they watch such an old movie. It's also weird how Camille doesn't pick up on the fact that Humphrey likes her but in earlier seasons with other characters she seems to display more empathy.
